coordinates.billboard_note: All release textures use screen-facing quads anchored to projected positions. Do not squash their already-painted forms a second time. Stomp ground pivot maps to circle center. Beam axis follows the projected hand-to-wall vector; transverse scale follows the warned lane geometry.

additive_blend.note: If engine uses One/One, premultiply RGB by texture alpha in shader first. Global opacity must multiply the premultiplied result. Never add raw RGB of transparent texels.

assets.sampling: warning progress; independent runtime scale pulse

charge.anchor: Same projected hand anchor as frozen beam-head.
charge.timing: Full scheduled warning: 1s tracking plus1.3-2.8s lock, longer enraged. Never add gameplay delay.

lines.texture_layout: 60 horizontal cels: five progress banks, each12-frame looping animation. No legacy consumer adapter.
lines.dimensions: 5-7px base width;14-30px initial/visible segment lengths before absorption; maximum90px field.
lines.motion: Uneven inward packets shorten; tips stay separate from core until last cel enters beneath rim at40%alpha. Beam-side bias, no uniform ring.

core.pulse: Multiply quad size about anchor by1+0.025*sin(2*pi*7*elapsed_seconds). Do not multiply by warning progress again.
core.art: Dense painted white/cyan centre with violet outer rim. Glow intentionally exceeds frozen aperture.
core.release: Retain frame8 atop frozen head first frames; opacity=max(0,1-(now-release_at)/0.060). Freeze pulse phase at release if needed; never delay beam. Remove after60ms.

charge.release: Head/body start on authoritative release at same hand anchor; lines clear; core fades60ms above head.
charge.bounds: Face uncovered at sampled pose. Far lane clear. Enraged scales all1.5x, matching60->90px head. Socket/pose validation remains runtime responsibility.

head.shape: Short rounded funnel from small aperture to full solid beam width. Head right edge joins body.

body.axis_end: wall contact; hard clip at wall
body.warning_footprint: All solid head/body remain within actual projected warned lane. Use projected polygon width, not unprojected world width for arbitrary angles.

wall.mode: Body ends flush at wall. No wall flare, mirrored star, or separate splash asset.
